summary: M0 model-only verdict: BENIGN @ 0.72. All sign-ins come from the same device (dev-ng-01) and the same city (Manisa, TR) over a multi-week pattern: campus network (AS-AEGEAN-EDU) by day with no MFA, and TTNET by evening with MFA prompted and approved. No impossible travel, no new device, no new ASN/country, and MFA_approved results indicate the account holder was present. Mail signals (phish_suspect delivery from lookalike aegean-edu.com.tr; an OWA rule moving mail to a local "Arşiv-2026" archive) show no external forwarding, no evidence the phish was clicked, and no anomalous access following them. Suspicious signals are explained by normal dual-location behavior and routine mail handling; no confirmed account takeover.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
